name: plugin-kit
description: Start a new Claude Code plugin that meets the repository test bar on day one: `/plugin-kit:new-plugin` scaffolds the fail-open hook runner, one handler per event, the five-fault hook-contract test, the canary live run, the fixtures rule, a skill with its "When this can't run" section, and the how-it-fails receipt, so `ledger gate check` passes before the first rule is written.
